summary.intent: Execute all plans across waves in GSD phase 68.1 (web client runtime integration) using an orchestrator that discovers plans, groups them into dependency-based waves, and spawns per-plan subagents to implement each one.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (plan 68.1-01, owned write-body foundation) completed after a mid-stream stall was resolved via background resume — 5 commits landed, 266/266 SDK tests passed, STATE/ROADMAP updated. Wave 2 (plans 02, 03, 05, 07, 08) was then spawned in parallel to continue execution.

repo: GSD phase 68.1 plans have file-level dependencies: plans 02 and 08 both touch packages/sdk/src/client.ts, forcing sequential execution order (02, 03, 05, 07, 08) within that wave despite being nominally parallel-eligible.

Plan 68.1-01's task 3 (threading writeKey/writeChildren through owned publishes) required touching packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts even though the plan's file list only implied client.ts — deleteToBin/restoreFromBin publish calls live there.

CipherBoxClientConfig.rootWriteKey was made optional (mirroring rootIpnsKeypair) even though the plan implied it should be required, since self-bootstrap needs both and host wiring is deferred to plan 68.1-03.
Test fixtures (helpers.ts, bin.test.ts) needed updates for the new required FolderState.writeKey field, using a zero-key legacy path to preserve no-network publish behavior in unit tests.
workflow: GSD execute-phase workflow has a documented completion-signal fallback for stalled subagents: when a wave agent stops mid-stream, spot-check filesystem/git state before deciding whether to resume or restart it.

A stalled subagent can be resumed via SendMessage to its task/agent id, preserving its full context, rather than restarting it from scratch — it then completed its remaining work (commit + SUMMARY + STATE update) in the background.

Flag activation in this GSD workflow is strictly literal: a documented optional flag (--wave, --gaps-only, --interactive) is only treated as active if its exact token appears in the phase argument string, never inferred from context.

Wave transitions in this workflow include explicit gates: post-merge build gate, test gate scoped to the affected package, and wave:post drift-check hooks, run before spawning the next wave's subagents.

friction: Wave 1's subagent for plan 68.1-01 stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 minutes) with no completion signal, requiring the orchestrator to spot-check state and manually resume it rather than proceeding automatically.
Wave 1 execution took materially longer than expected (~28 min execution plus a separate orchestrator resume cycle) due to the stall.
open_items: Host wiring for rootWriteKey self-bootstrap (mentioned as deferred to plan 68.1-03) still needs to land.
Wave 2 (plans 02, 03, 05, 07, 08) was just spawned and its results were not yet available at the end of the transcript.

Plans covering preview UI, share/invite creation, version surface, and kind-cache wiring (later waves) and the final phase-close steps (code_review gate, regression gate, gsd-verifier, phase.complete, PROJECT.md update) are still pending.
